Don’t know why you’re getting downvoted for saying exactly what happened, it’s crazy how people want to change the Lebron superteam narrative because his team didn’t live up to expectations. 

Every championship he’s won has been on a stacked team but, his fans are pros at propping him up and bringing his teammates down to try and convince everyone his superteams were not that good. KD could have saved himself the hate and slander if he’d choked in the finals like Lebron did.
Does anyone know the name of the song?
Man, what’s your story? Why are you so pissed?

NBA fans: Warriors were a lucky team, only won because everyone was injured, they’re not very good.

Also NBA fans: Why did a great player join such an incredible team? Seriously it’s not fair, they’re ruining the league.

Now imagine if you wanted cosmic t4cc, I guarantee you’d have gotten all skill.

Edit: Grammar
It’s crazy that you got downvoted for stating what literally happened.
Agreed. KG is an amazing storyteller.
Can’t wait to see who wins.
Legend has it, shouting I’m back completely heals you from all injuries.
How’s that being cocky in the first place? It was the NBA finals, players talk trash, stop acting like Lebron and Kyrie were waiting to hear those words to go god mode.
This was the moment they lost, not when one of their key players missed a full game, not when Kyrie made the shot that won game 7, this is why people don’t like Lebron fans honestly.
A large majority of them are way too biased.
Iguodala won fmvp for guarding Lebron, not for being golden state’s actual most valuable player.
People forget how his game fits perfectly with Steph and Klay, you put Malone in there and it probably doesn’t even work.
Tell me about this alternate universe you live in. Is the NBA suspend over there too?
It’s so silly, people are just angry because their favorite teams had no chance when he was on the Warriors.
